profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fairmoney
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 6 years of working experience. In the course of my career, I have led and mentored teams of software engineers and guiding them to their fullest potential while achieving business goals. I am Skilled in C++, Go, Python, PHP, Mobile Applications, Laravel, and Javascript. I am a Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) focused in Computer Science(Information Systems) from Babcock University.

positions.description: Working as a software engineer at Andela's partner engineering team, helping Andela's partners build software products

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building Modules to Integrate with global carrier services using Rest, soap and graphql technologies.
Maintaining and debugging several Carrier Integrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-> Developed A Trivia Solution with a team of 4 Engineers.
-> Developed MTN Smart Survey, Mtn Smart Survey application is a platform that enables
partners to reach potential users who are willing to take mtn survey questions at any point via SMS and USSD. The mobile app survey application communicates with Mtn database to fetch users that suites the customers requirements.
-> Developed Terragon’s Reward Service with a team of Developers, The reward service is a solution for topping up airtime on a phone number.
-> Developed Taja Adrenaline Marketing Platform. Taja is a platform for SMEs to quickly integrate into Adrenaline’s marketing channel.
-> Led the software development team that built the Sponsored Data Platform. The sponsored data platform is a web application designed for serving video ads on a zero-rated web-page, tracking user interactivity/engagement on the ads and a CMS for
Creating Ad and viewing metrics.
-> Developed the Adrenaline 2.0 frontend with Angular.

Technology Stack:
- Node.js
- Python
- Java
- USSD (Gateway application)
- REST
- MongoDB
- Redis
- MySQL
- RabbitMQ
- Docker (including using DockerHub's build pipeline)
- Git (GitHub and Bitbucket - including using the build pipelines)
- AWS (Lambda function, S3, SQS, EC2)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Was responsible for building software based on the need of other departments and sister companies of the Concept Group to help eliminate human inefficiency in operations. 
- Designed and developed an IT asset management web application for the IT and Networking department to help handle and keep note of the status of assets from procurement to assignment to a staff.
- Designed and developed a Staff Loan Management application to help the HR department keep track of loans given out to staff members.
- Designed and developed a ticketing system
DEVELOPMENT STACK:
  - Laravel
  - Node-js 
  - JQuery 
  - Html
  - CSS

positions.title: Intern developer
positions.description:
Making upgrades to existing WordPress themes built by the team.
Building APIs with NodeJS and MongoDB
